title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: How to display/add “Sent To” on the Sent Emails (8883, List) page?
summary: The Sent Emails page (8883) shows the sender but not the recipients. The post adds a Sent To column with a page extension that reads the internal Message Id from table Sent Email via RecordRef and FieldRef, then calls Get and GetRecipients on the public Email Message codeunit to build a semicolon-separated list of To recipients.
key_points: Sent Emails uses a temporary source table, and table 8889 Sent Email has no Sent To field; all its fields except Id are internal.
The standard Email Viewer gets recipients through Email Message Impl., which is internal and cannot be used from an extension.
The public codeunit Email Message offers Get and GetRecipients, which can stand in for the internal implementation.
RecordRef and FieldRef on the Sent Email table get around the internal access to read the Message Id in OnAfterGetRecord.
